# Native Abdominal Zero-Translation Reduction

## Scope and Mechanical Authority

Issue #12161 implements recipe `buet-abdjnt-zero-translations/1` after the
source-bound anatomy assembly in #12157. BUET's `Abdjnt` CustomJoint contains
surviving rotation `Abs_r3` and locked zero translations `Abs_t1`/`Abs_t2`.
Moco rejects the translation locks. Whole-joint welding would discard the
rotation and its enforced `Abs_r3_con` coupling to `flex_extension`.

The maintained operation changes only the two identity translation functions
to `Constant(0)` with empty coordinate lists and removes their Coordinate
properties. It creates a fresh XML artifact and reloads it natively. No source
model, muscle parameter, passive law, preparation or surviving joint is
repaired. Source SHA and exact reviewed native joint/coupler property digests
constrain admission. Unknown removed-coordinate consumers in XML text,
attributes and tails reject. Nonzero default, achieved or declared observation
targets/speeds and prescriptions reject. Never clear native live coordinate
properties: the earlier experiment crashed during finalization.

On the locked zero manifold, each eliminated identity translation evaluates
exactly to zero and its permitted speed is zero. Constant replacement therefore
preserves the transform on this particular manifold. This argument does not
apply to arbitrary nonzero targets, other axes/functions or another coupling.

## State, Force and Numerical Verification

The caller supplies immutable complete named continuous states for explicit
observations. Source and derived states initialize using retained native default
modeling options. Every declared source value must read back exactly, including
removed zero states; every retained value must restore exactly in both models.
The operation does not equilibrate, assemble, project or integrate. These
observations are not complete-state replay admission.

Fresh reload must preserve native body, force, constraint, marker, unrelated
joint and retained coordinate property dumps. Exactly four named continuous
states disappear. Reuse the reviewed zero-MTP comparison helper for transforms,
body velocities, muscle lengths, common-coordinate and full native mass, and
rank-complete mobility lift. Applied force is
$J_{system}^{T} f_{body} + f_{mobility}$ before velocity bias and constraint
reactions; direct mobility force alone is insufficient. Additional scalar
observations compare native muscle lengthening speed and actuation, rejecting
nonfinite readbacks before maxima accumulation.

Each sampled difference has a diagnostic limit of $10^{-9}$ in its native SI
quantity; labels distinguish transform entries, m, m/s, N, mixed-coordinate
mass and N/Nm generalized force. These are recipe regression limits, not
physiological tolerances. The receipt binds recipe, source, derived output,
implementation/helper, runtime binaries and exact ordered observations. Output
SHA is frozen before fresh reload and checked again afterward. Failed derived
artifacts remain diagnostic outputs and cannot be overwritten.

## Evidence and Reproduction

Use the installed OpenSim 4.6 SDK with `CASADIPATH` pointing to its package and
checkout-first `PYTHONPATH`. Set `BUET_REDUCTION_SOURCE` to the retained caller
owned model and `BUET_REDUCTION_PREPARED` to its preparation receipt, then run:

```powershell
python3 -m pytest -o addopts='' tests/opensim/test_native_abdominal_reduction.py
```

The actual native 473-muscle source passes fresh-reload comparison at baseline
and coupled flexion/extension observations. Native Moco solver initialization
succeeds after reduction; no trajectory solve follows. Negative tests retain
source mismatch, targets/speeds, locks, frames, coupling, unknown consumers and
incomplete state failures. The first test used the wrong API spelling
`setModelCopy`; the installed binding requires `setModelAsCopy`. A declared
nonzero removed state initially escaped through native readback; explicit
request and full source-readback validation now rejects it. Failed receipts
remain in local planning storage. Final validation and assembled-model evidence
are recorded in the turnover as they complete.

## Remaining Qualification Gates

This source retains 473 muscles, 17 couplers and all auxiliary muscle states;
q/u drop from 54 to 52. The separately assembled 557-muscle source is independently measured at
three coupled poses: ten maximum mechanical differences are zero, with
rank60/condition1. Its source-specific one-equilibrium preparation changes554
fiber-length states while preserving q/u/time/activation/options/source;
passive suitability remains unqualified. The abdominal reduction leaves four
distal locks (bilateral subtalar and MTP), so assembled Moco initialization
still rejects. Use `BUET_ASSEMBLED_REDUCTION_SOURCE` and
`BUET_ASSEMBLED_REDUCTION_PREPARED` for this separate native test. The retained
JSON receipt binds preparation and observation helper digests. Large passive psoas loading, conditional path discontinuities,
wrist source authority, support/grip/contact, native private capture registration,
whole-horizon muscle control and independent saved-excitation replay remain
open. All 17 variants across six ecosystems stay in the parity denominator.
The recipe and solver initialization do not qualify model physiology or release.
